description: Read this workspace's operating manual: the house rules for writing here (style, tag taxonomy, memory vs collection, what belongs and what does not). Follow it when you remember/publish. `recall` and `brief` both return it inline as `guide`, so you normally already have it and do not need this call. Falls back to a sensible default until someone customises it.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: get_workspace_guide

body.description: body is the workspace operating manual (markdown).

isDefault.description: is_default is true when body is the built-in default (no owner has set one).

updatedBy.description: updated_by is the id of the member who last saved it (empty for the default).

version.description: version increments on each edit; 0 means the built-in default (never edited).

title: Read the workspace guide
